title: A Place for Me to Be Me
subtitle: After six years of startups, I want to use the internet a little differently.
html:
So I am Mark but most of my friends call me Kram.

THE INTERNET, UNTIL NOW

In the past, I’ve used the internet as a library and as a journal. It has been a place to consume content and a place to jot down half-finished thoughts. Passive and personal. An experience inclined towards scrolling.

The internet has also been a place associated with work -- ghostwriting blogs and running corporate social media accounts and spinning narrative and such. All stuff I love and that has contained a fair bit of my personality, but has left me feeling a bit ghostly. I have been too long behind the keys for content and opinions I didn’t have to fully own.

As I take some time off from work -- it’s been six years of startups since dropping out of school, how time flies -- my relationship with the internet is going to change a bit.

It’s time for me to be a bit more, me.

FROM HERE

So, starting today, the internet is a place I am going to be fully authentic, with the aim to collect and distribute. To actively curate content and share thoughts publicly. An experience inclined towards action.

This means a lot of posts will be erupting from my channels. A lot of them personal. Many of them tinkering with new form factors for ideas and weird words. Only a few about technology?

Most content will be about the stuff I care about and why.

IN GENERAL, I BELIEVE...

  • friendship is the most important salve for scrolling

  • life should be lived as if you get one shot at it

  • fiat will eventually be replaced by an algorithmic flatcoin

  • grand romance is alive and well and should be more consistently espoused

  • terraforming is probably the most interesting place to be researching right now

If any of those things bother you, well, I guess I’m posting this so you have time to unfollow this page before I start blitzing content.

If any of those things interest you or someone you know, well, then hello again. I’m Mark, most of my friends call me Kram, and you will hopefully be seeing a lot more from me in the coming weeks.

The first series of posts I have coming up is called KINETIC. It is a six-part series about my time traveling across Ireland, London, Berlin, Greece, and Liberia earlier this year.

- Kram
